pins.title: An afternoon nap · おひるね
pins.desc:
A pixel Shiba Inu takes an afternoon nap in the garden. Pikomofu is a cozy pixel pet app for iPhone: a little garden under the real sky, where the time of day, the seasons and the moon are real. One pet free, no ads.
